messages:
maia: Quick copy pass — need to lock CTAs & inbound routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages by EOD so eng can wire forms. Proposed CTAs: Hosted = 'Start free', Dedicated = 'Request reserved capacity', Private = 'Request demo'. Anyone see a conflict?

liam: I like that split. One ask: can Hosted also have a 'Compare plans' secondary CTA for buyers who land on that page? Conversion wise it helps.

sophie: Design perspective: make Private CTA more subtle but still prominent (outline style vs primary). 'Request demo' feels less salesy than 'Talk to sales'. Hero anchors: Hosted -> latency & cost; Dedicated -> throughput & SLA; Private -> compliance & KMS. I'll sketch variants. :art: 

arjun: Product note: add anchor links for 'See benchmarks' on Hosted (benchmarks host), 'Capacity options' on Dedicated (commit/overage), and 'Compliance & KMS' for Private. Also would prefer CTA text 'Request reserved capacity' -> 'Get reserved capacity' (more active).

ben: Engineering/ops note: please avoid separate forms per CTA. Use one lead-capture endpoint with a hidden 'mode' param so routing pipelines can pick. Example: 
```html
<form action="/lead-capture" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="mode" value="HOSTED"> <!-- HOSTED | DEDICATED | PRIVATE -->
  <button type="submit">Start free</button>
</form>
```
Server will map mode -> pipeline (self-serve vs sales-enterprise). Also include UTM/ga clientId so we don't lose attribution.

maia: Good call. Action items: @sophie update hero comps and CTA states; @arjun add anchor targets and confirm exact anchor IDs; @ben confirm analytics param naming and implement /lead-capture; @liam consolidate plan compare messaging for Hosted secondary CTA. 3pm review? :calendar:

liam: 3pm works, I will bring recent conversion numbers for Hosted and Dedicated.

sophie: I'll push a Figma update to marketing/landing and ping this thread with links.

ben: I'll stub /lead-capture and add docs in ops-spec. tagging ops-bot for a preview build.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: preview build started for branch maia/landing-cta (build #4257). ETA ~6m.

maia: Thanks all — I'll post the final copy here before handoff to eng. :thumbsup:
